summary: A Delta Junction jury acquitted Andrew Rihel on Nov. 6 of four felony counts of sexual abuse of a minor. Alaska State Troopers reported eight incidents in the Fairbanks area on Nov. 6, among them four arrests, two of them on domestic violence charges. The Fairbanks court opened six criminal files during the Nov. 6 court day, and four of the six record no charge at all. The Alaska Court System's weekly charges report, which now covers Oct. 31 to Nov. 6, lists 42 Fairbanks cases, three at Delta Junction, one at Nenana and none at Healy.

entries.title: Jury acquits Andrew Rihel of four felony counts
body: A Delta Junction jury returned a verdict on Nov. 6 in the case of Andrew Rihel, who was charged with two counts of sexual abuse of a minor in the first degree, an unclassified felony, and two counts of sexual abuse of a minor in the second degree, a Class B felony. The court file records a judgment of acquittal on the same day.

The counts were returned by a grand jury and carried an offense date of Jan. 30, 2023 at Delta Junction. The trial sat on Nov. 3, Nov. 4, Nov. 5 and Nov. 6, one of those days at the Fairbanks courthouse and the rest at Delta Junction, before Judge Brent E. Bennett.
No count on the file carries a conviction. Case 4DJ-24-00006CR.

entries.title: Domestic violence arrest: Dustin Walters
body: Dustin Walters was arrested on charges of assault in the fourth degree, unlawful contact, two counts of assault in the presence of a child, and violating conditions of release. Assault in the fourth degree is recklessly injuring another person or placing them in fear of injury.

Troopers say they responded to a residence on Lakeview Terrace in Fairbanks on Nov. 6 for a report of a domestic disturbance, and that Walters was on house arrest at the time. He was remanded to Fairbanks Correctional Center.

A separate Fairbanks case against him, 4FA-26-02001CR, charging theft in the third degree and criminal trespass in the first degree, has been open since October and is set for a pre-trial conference on Dec. 17.

entries.title: Assault arrest: Terrance Mouton
body: Terrance Mouton was arrested on charges of assault in the fourth degree and criminal mischief in the fifth degree. Assault in the fourth degree is recklessly injuring another person; criminal mischief in the fifth degree is damaging another person's property.

Troopers say they received a report of a disturbance at the La Quinta Inn in Fairbanks at about 9:37 p.m. on Nov. 6 and that an assault had taken place. He was remanded to Fairbanks Correctional Center.

entries.title: DUI arrest: Chantz Chandler
body: Chantz Chandler, 20, was arrested on a charge of driving under the influence — operating a vehicle while impaired by alcohol or drugs.

Troopers say they stopped a vehicle traveling 64 mph in a posted 45 mph zone on Geist Road in Fairbanks at about 3:37 a.m. on Nov. 6, that the driver showed signs of impairment, and that he later gave a breath sample of .152. They say he was also cited for consumption of alcohol by a person under 21. He was remanded to Fairbanks Correctional Center.
Case 4FA-26-02238CR; arraignment Nov. 13.

entries.title: Criminal trespass arrest: John Franklin Erlich Jr.
body: John Franklin Erlich Jr. was arrested on a charge of criminal trespass in the second degree — entering or remaining unlawfully upon premises.

Troopers say they responded to a report of a possible burglary in progress off Lake View Terrace in Fairbanks at about 6:21 a.m. on Nov. 6 and contacted a man matching the description on the premises of the reported residence. He was remanded to Fairbanks Correctional Center.
Case 4FA-26-02239CR; arraignment Nov. 13.

entries.title: Driving while license revoked arrest: Allen Broeke
body: Allen Broeke was arrested on a charge of driving while license revoked.

Troopers say he was stopped on the Richardson Highway near the Department of Transportation scales at North Pole at about 10:49 a.m. on Nov. 6 after being observed speeding, and that a records check showed his license revoked and a prior conviction for the same offense in November 2024.

entries.title: Assault charge: Amber Serenity Brahma
body: Amber Serenity Brahma, 33, is charged with assault in the fourth degree — causing fear of imminent injury — a Class A misdemeanor on the court file.

The charge was filed at Fairbanks in March and a summons was served on Nov. 6. Fairbanks Police recorded an arrest the same day at the 100 block of Lacey Street, which is the address of the Fairbanks courthouse. Police case 25003838.
Case 4FA-26-00414CR; arraignment Nov. 17.

entries.title: DUI charge: Sanna Naomi Nell Hein
body: Sanna Naomi Nell Hein, 31, is charged with driving under the influence of alcohol or a controlled substance, a Class A misdemeanor, and with violating conditions of release on a misdemeanor charge, a Class B misdemeanor.

The offenses are dated Sep. 11 at Fairbanks. She was arraigned on Nov. 6 and counsel was appointed. Fairbanks Police recorded an arrest the same day at the 100 block of Lacey Street, which is the address of the Fairbanks courthouse. Police case 26002808.
Case 4FA-26-01956CR; pre-trial conference Dec. 31.

entries.title: Unlawful contact and release violations: Thomas James Madison Grover
body: Thomas James Madison Grover is charged with unlawful contact — contacting a person a court order forbids him from contacting — a Class A misdemeanor recorded by the court as domestic violence related, and with two counts of violating conditions of release for a misdemeanor, each a Class B misdemeanor.
The offenses are dated Nov. 5 at Fairbanks. He was arraigned Nov. 6 and counsel was appointed.
Case 4FA-26-02240CR; pre-trial conference Dec. 10.

entries.title: DUI arrest: Joshua Thomas Slagle
body: Joshua Thomas Slagle, 41, was arrested on a charge of driving under the influence of alcohol or a controlled substance, recorded by police as a misdemeanor.
100 block of College Road, Fairbanks, Nov. 5 at 8:35 p.m.; Fairbanks Police. A $500 cash bond was posted.
Case 4FA-26-02236CR; arraignment Nov. 13.

entries.title: Traffic citations and an unfiled criminal case: David Heater
body: David Heater was cited at Fairbanks on Nov. 6 for failing to exercise due care to avoid a collision, a non-criminal minor offense carrying a $150 fine, and for failing to carry and exhibit proof of insurance on demand, a non-criminal offense carrying a $500 fine.

A criminal case was opened against him the same day with an offense date of Nov. 6. The court file records the charge as a charging document pending or not filed, so no charge and no charge class is stated on it. He was released on standard conditions.
Cases 4FA-26-05563MO and 4FA-26-05564MO; criminal case 4FA-26-02237CR, arraignment Nov. 13.

entries.title: Warrant to issue after missed arraignment: Jennifer Morgan Lofrano
body: Jennifer Morgan Lofrano is charged with criminal trespass in the second degree — entering or remaining unlawfully upon premises — a Class B misdemeanor, with an offense date of Oct. 31 at Fairbanks.

She did not appear at an arraignment set for 8:30 a.m. on Nov. 6 and the court file records that a warrant is to issue. A pre-trial conference set for Dec. 24 and a trial week set for Jan. 4, 2027 are both recorded vacated.
Case 4FA-26-02207CR.

entries.title: DUI arrest after College Road collision
body: Troopers say they responded to a reported motor vehicle collision on College Road in Fairbanks on Nov. 5 that resulted in an arrest for driving under the influence. No name has been released and troopers say the investigation is ongoing.

entries.title: Cell phone reported stolen in Fairbanks
body: A cell phone was reported stolen in the area of Lakeview Terrace in Fairbanks on Nov. 6. Troopers say no suspect has been identified and the case is ongoing.

entries.title: Utility trailer reported stolen at North Pole
body: A dual-axle utility trailer was reported stolen from a property at North Pole at about 10:50 a.m. on Nov. 5. Troopers say there are no suspects or leads and that the trailer was placed in stolen status.

entries.title: Shoplifting reported in Fairbanks
body: A shoplifting was reported at the 900 block of Old Steese Highway in Fairbanks at about 5:22 p.m. on Nov. 5; Fairbanks Police. Police case 26003381.

entries.title: Assault arrest: Corinna Lucille Sheri Gray
body: Corinna Lucille Sheri Gray, 35, was arrested on a charge of assault in the fourth degree — recklessly injuring another person — recorded by police as a misdemeanor.
Fairbanks Police recorded the arrest on Nov. 4 at the 100 block of Lacey Street, which is the address of the Fairbanks courthouse. Police case 26002692.

entries.title: Criminal trespass charge: Rachel Renee Hancock
body: Rachel Renee Hancock, 26, of Healy is charged with criminal trespass in the second degree — entering or remaining unlawfully upon premises — a Class B misdemeanor.
Troopers say they received a report of trespassing at a Healy gas station on Oct. 30, could not locate her that day, and issued her a misdemeanor summons on Nov. 4.
Case 4NE-26-00109CR; arraignment Nov. 16 at the Nenana courthouse.

entries.title: DUI charges: Chad James De Long
body: Chad James De Long is charged with driving under the influence of alcohol or a controlled substance, with refusing to submit to a chemical test, and with driving while his license was canceled, revoked or suspended for a criminal offense. Each count is a Class A misdemeanor on the court file.
The offenses are dated Oct. 31 at Delta Junction. He was arraigned Nov. 1 and a cash performance bond was posted Nov. 3.
Case 4DJ-26-00069CR; rural calendar call Dec. 15 at the Delta Junction courthouse.
